description: This Java source file defines the UploadContentAndImage class, which provides methods for uploading, processing, and managing content and associated images within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes functionalities for handling multipart form uploads, creating/updating content entities, managing content associations, and error handling.

classes.name: UploadContentAndImage
classes.description: Contains methods for uploading, processing, and managing content and images, including handling multipart requests, creating content entities, and managing associations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: uploadContentAndImage
methods.description: Handles the upload of content and image files, processes multipart form data, creates or updates content entities, and manages content associations within a transaction scope.

methods.name: uploadContentStuff
methods.description: Processes batch content upload requests, parses multipart form data with multiple files, and performs content creation or updates, handling errors and transactions.

methods.name: processContentUpload
methods.description: Processes individual content upload entries, runs associated mini-language map processors for content and data resource creation, and manages content associations.
